differences: Mean age of the 75 participants is 19.640 years (SD 1.530) here, printed as 19.6 (1.5) in the paper; the paper's decimals look truncated rather than rounded, so the checks allow one unit of the last digit.

For the four Experiment 2 participants whose trial 500 is empty, the subject info's game points are lower than the trial file's last cumulative points, by 10245 to 32435 points; for the other 71 participants they are equal.

The paper's Welch t-test of key presses per trial in the first 200 trials (Mapping vs Full, t(35.42) = -14.75) is not reproduced by the participants' mean number of key presses (t = -9.475, 24 degrees of freedom); the measure behind it is not stated.

646 trials are logged as arrivals after the 10 s limit with feedback type 0 and 0 points, and 10 trials logged at exactly 10000 ms have points although the logged cells do not end on the target; both are kept as logged.
